comparisons.peer_summary: AMD maintains worldwide operations relying on third-party wafer foundries in the US, Europe, and Asia, with product assembly and testing performed in China, Malaysia, and Taiwan, while international sales accounted for 66% of net revenue in 2024.
comparisons.comparison: Both AMD and NVIDIA disclose significant international exposure and reliance on third-party manufacturing outside the US. NVIDIA reported 56% of revenue from outside the US with third-party manufacturing in non-US locations, while AMD reported 66% of net revenue from international sales and relies on third-party foundries in the US, Europe, and Asia. Both companies highlight their global operational footprint as a key business characteristic, though AMD's international revenue percentage was higher than NVIDIA's.
